# Review

> The literature review as a genre of the reader-ergonomics family: the five steps, the files of a review (frame, protocol, sources, review, against, state of the art, position, baseline, references), the grey scoring, the second rater and the flow, as shapes with examples and checks. Scope only; the shapes are not yet written.

Each page's markdown source is served at the same path with a .md extension. This index is written by hand; AGENTS.md says to keep it in step.

## The repository

- [Review](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-review/README.md): the scope, the first job and the questions its review must answer
- [Decisions](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-review/decisions/README.md): one record per choice that shapes the repository

## Contributing

- [Contributing](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-review/AGENTS.md): rules for changing this repository
- [Standard](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics/standard.md): the reader-ergonomics card this repository obeys
